description: Making health systems exchange data that both sides understand: the levels of interoperability, clinical terminologies such as ICD, SNOMED CT and LOINC, HL7 version 2 messaging and CDA documents, FHIR resources and RESTful APIs, patient identity and record matching, health information exchange architectures and a working FHIR integration. Practised hands-on with browser-based message parsers, terminology browsers and a FHIR server sandbox, linking simulated clinics, laboratories and a district reporting system.
modelledOn: HL7 International, FHIR R4 specification and HL7 Version 2 messaging standard
Benson and Grieve, Principles of Health Interoperability: FHIR, HL7 and SNOMED CT
WHO, International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10 and ICD-11)
IHE International, IT Infrastructure Technical Framework
outcomes: Explain technical, syntactic, semantic and organisational interoperability and the cost of its absence in a health system.
Code clinical data with ICD, SNOMED CT and LOINC and map between local codes and standard terminologies.
Parse, construct and validate HL7 version 2 messages and explain the structure of CDA clinical documents.
Model clinical data as FHIR resources and query and update a FHIR server through its RESTful API with appropriate security.
Design patient identification and record matching with master patient indexes and deterministic and probabilistic matching.
Design and build an integration between health applications through a health information exchange using IHE profiles and FHIR.

units.title: Why interoperability matters
topics: Fragmented systems in practice: repeated tests, lost referrals, duplicate reporting, siloed vertical programmes
Levels of interoperability: foundational, structural, semantic and organisational
The standards landscape: HL7, ISO health informatics standards, CEN, IHE, WHO, DICOM, openEHR; how standards are developed
National digital health strategies and enterprise architectures; OpenHIE as a reference
A referral from a CHPS compound to a district hospital traced through systems that do not talk

units.title: Terminologies: ICD, SNOMED CT and LOINC
topics: Terminologies, classifications and code systems: purpose, granularity, versioning
ICD-10 and ICD-11: chapters, coding rules, mortality and morbidity coding, use in insurance claims
SNOMED CT: concepts, descriptions, relationships, hierarchies, post-coordination and expression constraints
LOINC for laboratory tests and observations; UCUM units; RxNorm and ATC for medicines
Mapping local codes to standards; value sets and terminology services
Coding diagnoses and procedures for NHIS claims and district reports in Ghana

units.title: HL7 messaging
topics: HL7 version 2: segments, fields, components, delimiters, encoding; MSH, PID, PV1, OBR and OBX segments
Message types and trigger events: ADT admissions and transfers, ORM orders, ORU results; acknowledgements
Interface engines and message routing, transformation and error handling
HL7 version 3 and the Reference Information Model in brief; why it saw limited adoption
Clinical Document Architecture: header, structured body, templates; discharge summaries and referral letters
Building a laboratory results interface between a hospital laboratory and a records system

units.title: FHIR resources and APIs
topics: FHIR principles: resources, references, data types, JSON and XML representations
Core resources: Patient, Practitioner, Organization, Encounter, Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest, Immunization
RESTful interactions: read, search with parameters and chaining, create, update, delete, history; bundles and transactions
Profiles, extensions and implementation guides; validating resources against profiles
Terminology in FHIR: CodeSystem, ValueSet, ConceptMap and terminology operations
Security: SMART on FHIR, OAuth 2.0 scopes, audit events and consent resources
Bulk data export and FHIR for public health reporting

units.title: Patient identity and matching
topics: Why identity is hard: naming conventions, missing birth dates, shared phone numbers, transliteration
Master patient indexes and enterprise identifiers; national IDs such as the Ghana Card and NHIS numbers
Deterministic and probabilistic record linkage; the Fellegi-Sunter model, blocking and match thresholds
Measuring matching quality: false matches versus missed matches and their clinical risk
Biometrics and privacy-preserving linkage; IHE PIX and PDQ profiles

units.title: Health information exchanges
topics: Exchange architectures: point-to-point, hub and spoke, federated and centralised models
OpenHIE components: interoperability layer, client registry, facility registry, health worker registry, shared health record, terminology service
IHE profiles for document sharing (XDS) and mobile access (MHD)
Aggregate exchange with ADX and linking patient-level systems to DHIS2
Governance, consent, data sharing agreements and Data Protection Act 843 obligations
Case studies of national health information exchanges in Africa

units.title: Building a FHIR integration
topics: Requirements and data mapping from a clinic system to FHIR resources
Implementing a client that searches, creates and updates resources against a FHIR server
Testing with validators and test servers; conformance statements and capability statements
Error handling, retries and offline queues for unreliable connections
Project: an integration that sends immunisation or laboratory data from a simulated clinic to a shared record and a district report

schedule.title: Fragmentation and levels of interoperability
schedule.exercise: Trace a patient referral from a CHPS compound to a district hospital, mark every point where data is retyped or lost, and classify each gap by interoperability level.

tasks.title: Classify six described data-exchange failures as foundational, structural, semantic or organisational interoperability problems and justify each choice
Draw a diagram of a CHPS-to-district-hospital referral across four unconnected systems, marking each manual handoff and the data lost there
Sketch an OpenHIE-style architecture for a regional health directorate connecting facility, lab and reporting systems, and justify each component

schedule.title: Classifications and clinical terminologies
schedule.exercise: Code ten clinical statements to ICD-10 and find a SNOMED CT concept and parent for three of them, noting where the two systems differ in granularity.

tasks.title: Query a loaded ICD-10 table to find and list the codes for five diagnoses, including malaria, typhoid and hypertension
Query a SNOMED CT subset to list all descendants of a disorder concept and count how many each level of the hierarchy holds
Code a set of discharge notes into ICD-10 following the coding rules for the principal diagnosis, and score against the rubric

schedule.title: Laboratory and medication codes, and mapping
schedule.exercise: Map a clinic's ten local test names and drug names to LOINC, UCUM and ATC codes, and write the value set for malaria tests used in a district report.

tasks.title: Look up LOINC codes for glucose, haemoglobin and malaria RDT in a loaded table and record each code's component and unit
Create a mapping table from 15 local lab codes to LOINC with SQL, and find unmapped rows and ambiguous matches
Code a batch of NHIS claims for diagnoses and procedures, find the coding errors that would cause rejection, and score against the rubric

schedule.title: HL7 version 2 messaging
schedule.exercise: Read an ADT^A01 admission message segment by segment, identify the patient, visit and ward fields, and write the acknowledgement that the receiver should return.

tasks.title: Parse a given HL7 v2 PID segment in Python by splitting delimiters and print the patient name, birth date and identifier
Write a function that builds an ORU^R01 result message with two OBX segments and check it parses back to the same values
Build a small router that sends ADT messages to one queue and ORU messages to another, and reports malformed messages in an error log

schedule.title: CDA documents and a laboratory interface
schedule.exercise: Outline the sections of a discharge summary as a CDA document, and write the field mapping table for a laboratory-to-records interface.

tasks.title: Read a given CDA discharge summary XML in Python and extract the patient, diagnosis and medication sections into a printed summary
Convert a lab system CSV export of 20 results into HL7 ORU messages and check each contains valid patient, test and result fields
Load incoming lab result messages into a records database, de-duplicate resent results, and flag results that arrive for unknown patients

schedule.title: FHIR resources and REST interactions
schedule.exercise: Write a Patient, an Encounter and an Observation resource as JSON for a clinic visit, with correct references between them, and the search URL to find the patient's blood pressure readings.

tasks.title: Create a valid FHIR Patient resource in JSON for a given person and print its name, gender and birth date fields
Use REST calls against a test FHIR server to create a Patient, read it back, and search for it by family name
Post a transaction bundle that creates a Patient, an Encounter and two Observations atomically, then verify the references resolve by chained search

schedule.title: FHIR profiles and terminology
schedule.exercise: Write a profile constraining Observation for malaria RDT results, with a required code and a bound value set, and list the validation errors it would raise on three sample resources.

tasks.title: Validate three FHIR resources against a given profile and report which required elements are missing in each
Build a CodeSystem and ValueSet for local malaria test results and check that a given Observation value is a member using the expand operation
Use a ConceptMap to translate 20 local diagnosis codes to ICD-10 in a script and report unmapped codes with suggested candidates

schedule.title: FHIR security and bulk data
schedule.exercise: Describe the OAuth 2.0 authorisation flow for a SMART app reading a patient's immunisations, naming the scopes requested and what audit event should be logged.

tasks.title: Choose the minimum SMART scopes for three app scenarios (immunisation viewer, lab results app, admin tool) and defend each choice
Write code to record an AuditEvent each time a Patient is read and verify the log contains who, what and when
Export 500 Immunization resources in bulk as newline-delimited JSON and compute district vaccination coverage counts from the export

schedule.title: Patient identity and record linkage
schedule.exercise: Compare 12 patient record pairs by hand using name, birth date and phone, assign each a match, possible match or non-match, and discuss the clinical risk of a false match.

tasks.title: Normalise 30 patient names by case, spacing and common transliteration variants and count how many duplicates the clean-up reveals
Implement deterministic and probabilistic matching on two small registers and compare matches found with a known answer key
Tune the match threshold of a Fellegi-Sunter linker on labelled pairs and plot false matches against missed matches to justify your cut-off

schedule.title: Health information exchange architecture
schedule.exercise: Compare point-to-point, hub-and-spoke and federated exchange for a region of 100 facilities, and sketch which OpenHIE components a referral workflow would call.

tasks.title: Draw point-to-point and hub-and-spoke connections for six systems and count the interfaces each design needs
Draw a sequence diagram of a referral using the client registry, facility registry and shared health record, naming each message
Deploy a document repository and registry on a cloud console, publish and retrieve a test clinical document, and measure retrieval time

schedule.title: Aggregate exchange, governance and case studies
schedule.exercise: Write a one-page data sharing agreement outline between a hospital and a research team, covering purpose, consent, security and obligations under the Ghana Data Protection Act.

tasks.title: Aggregate patient-level visit records into monthly counts by facility and diagnosis with SQL, ready for loading into a district reporting system
Decide how to respond to a researcher's request for patient data under the Data Protection Act and score against the consent rubric
Build an ADX-style aggregate payload from clinic data, validate it against a data set definition, and report rows that fail the checks

schedule.title: Building and testing a FHIR integration
schedule.exercise: Create a field-by-field mapping table from a clinic's visit register columns to FHIR Patient, Encounter and Observation elements, noting every column with no home.

tasks.title: Map each column of a given clinic visits table to a FHIR resource element and list the columns that need a coded value
Write a client that reads a clinic CSV and creates Patient and Observation resources on a test FHIR server, then searches to verify
Retrieve the server capability statement, test your client against it, and fix the resources that fail validation in a given batch

schedule.title: Reliable integration project
schedule.exercise: Document your integration project design, including data flow, mapping, error handling, privacy safeguards and a test plan, and present a demonstration with a rural connectivity failure.

tasks.title: Add a retry with increasing delay to a function that posts a resource and test it against a server that fails twice
Build an offline queue that stores 20 immunisation records while the link is down and sends them in order when it returns
Integrate a simulated clinic with a shared record and a district coverage report, handling duplicate and failed messages, and check final counts
